notes.associations: Counts describe proposed content associations, not adequate accounting coverage. A record may appear in several questions or industries; totals use unique record IDs.
notes.inheritance: Broader-industry and shared context remain separate. They do not establish specific coverage for a child industry.
notes.denominator: NAICS-US 2022 describes US economic activities. The question families are editorial proposals. Their cross-product is a screening space, not a list of applicable accounting requirements.
notes.assessment: Assessments apply only to their stated scope. Unassessed does not mean absent or inadequate. Metadata review does not establish professional sign-off or empirical performance.

metric_definitions.purpose: Prioritize research and review work across the accounting landscape. Breadth metrics are inventory diagnostics; scoped assessments are the evidence-review measure.
metric_definitions.population: The canonical records in the stated corpus version; no records are excluded from mapping-status totals.
metric_definitions.time_basis: Point-in-time versioned corpus snapshots, not source publication dates or evidence currency. The headline totals always describe the entire corpus, independent of the exploration filters.

definitions.title: Scoped research assessments
definitions.numerator: Assessments with a stated industry or shared context, question family, scope and review basis
definitions.caveat: A partial or not-applicable assessment is not adequate coverage. Inspect scope kind, status, seven depth dimensions, evidence and remaining gaps.

definitions.title: Question families with material
definitions.numerator: Question families referenced by at least one candidate or reviewed record mapping
definitions.denominator: All question families in the stated topology version
definitions.caveat: Adding a keyword association can raise this number without adding evidence. It does not measure sufficiency or source quality.

definitions.title: Sectors with associated material
definitions.numerator: Sectors with at least one record mapped at the sector or a descendant code
definitions.denominator: All sectors in the stated industry edition
definitions.caveat: Upward aggregation is useful for locating material. No downward credit is assigned to a subsector or detailed industry.

definitions.title: Records without question assignments
definitions.numerator: Records whose question_mappings array is empty
definitions.denominator: All canonical records in the stated corpus version
definitions.caveat: Unassigned records can still be relevant. A proposed assignment is not editorial review.

definitions.title: Industry mapping disposition
definitions.numerator: Mutually exclusive counts of specific, shared-context and unassigned industry scopes
definitions.denominator: All canonical records in the stated corpus version
definitions.caveat: These three counts must sum to the corpus total. Individual industry rows can overlap and must not be added together.

metric_definitions.comparison_rule: Compare snapshots only after reconciling corpus populations, topology editions, mapping methods and assessment definitions. A changed mapping method can change counts with no new research.
metric_definitions.target_policy: No completeness percentage or unsupported numerical target is assigned. Zero direct material, unassigned metadata, unassessed evidence and not-applicable findings remain distinct.

whole_scope_sufficiency.reason: Partial evidence and conditional applicability are retained; complete assessment does not mean complete evidence.

questions.title: Reporting basis and accounting policies
questions.screening_question: Which reporting entity, accounting basis, policy elections and effective requirements govern the question?

questions.title: Ledger, journals and period close
questions.screening_question: How do journals, accruals, reversals, cutoff and reconciliations produce a complete period ledger?

questions.title: Estimates and uncertainty
questions.screening_question: Which assumptions, specialists, revisions, bias indicators and sensitivities support estimates?

questions.title: Statements, disclosures and digital filing
questions.screening_question: How are ledger balances classified, consolidated into statements, disclosed and tied to filing concepts?

questions.title: Foreign currency and foreign operations
questions.screening_question: Which functional currencies, exchange rates, remeasurement and translation facts matter?

questions.title: Accounting changes, adoption and errors
questions.screening_question: Which transition cohorts, comparative periods and correction requirements apply?

questions.title: Subsequent events and going concern
questions.screening_question: What subsequent evidence, funding uncertainty and reporting-date boundaries require consideration?

questions.title: Reporting perimeter and consolidation
questions.screening_question: Which entities, interests, control relationships, eliminations and noncontrolling interests belong in the reporting perimeter?

questions.title: Revenue and customer contracts
questions.screening_question: What is promised, who is the customer, and how do performance, pricing, changes, returns and principal-agent roles affect the analysis?

questions.title: Contract costs, project WIP and estimates to complete
questions.screening_question: How do contract terms, progress evidence, cost forecasts, changes, billing and losses reconcile for each project?

questions.title: Purchasing, payables and expenses
questions.screening_question: How are supplier obligations, receipts, expenses, credits and unrecorded liabilities identified and reconciled?

questions.title: Receivables, collection and credit losses
questions.screening_question: Which rights to payment, collection populations, concessions and expected losses are supported?

questions.title: Cash, payments and settlement
questions.screening_question: How do bank, processor, payment-network and ledger records reconcile across timing and ownership differences?

questions.title: Inventory, conversion costs and cost of sales
questions.screening_question: Which quantities, ownership, cost layers, overhead allocations, spoilage and obsolescence affect inventory and margin?

questions.title: Capital assets and construction in progress
questions.screening_question: Which expenditures create owner assets, when are assets ready for use, and how are depreciation, retirements and disposals supported?

questions.title: Lessee and lessor arrangements
questions.screening_question: Which contracts convey asset-use rights, and how do options, modifications, embedded leases and party roles matter?

questions.title: Intangibles, software and research expenditure
questions.screening_question: What is being developed or acquired, who owns it, and which project stages, rights and costs require separate analysis?

questions.title: Payroll, labor costing and worker obligations
questions.screening_question: How do worker status, time, compensation, deductions, payroll taxes and work locations reconcile?

questions.title: Employee benefits and retirement arrangements
questions.screening_question: Which benefit promises, plan assets, funding duties and actuarial assumptions require accounting and reporting?

questions.title: Debt, financing costs and covenants
questions.screening_question: What borrowing terms, modifications, extinguishments, collateral and covenant definitions govern the financing?

questions.title: Equity and complex capital instruments
questions.screening_question: What ownership, redemption, conversion and distribution rights are attached to each instrument?

questions.title: Share-based compensation
questions.screening_question: Which awards, vesting conditions, modifications, settlement choices and valuation inputs affect compensation?

questions.title: Investments and financial assets
questions.screening_question: Which instruments, business purposes, measurement bases, impairment models and disposal events matter?

questions.title: Derivatives and hedging
questions.screening_question: Which contracts, embedded terms, risk exposures and designation evidence require derivative or hedge analysis?

questions.title: Fair value and impairment
questions.screening_question: Which units of account, markets, cash flows, assumptions and impairment triggers support the valuation?

questions.title: Digital assets and tokenized arrangements
questions.screening_question: What rights does the instrument convey, who controls it, and which asset, liability, custody or payment model applies?

questions.title: Income tax provision and uncertain positions
questions.screening_question: How do current taxes, temporary differences, recoverability and uncertain positions connect to the reporting entity?

questions.title: Sales, use, value-added, excise and customs taxes
questions.screening_question: Which transaction, customer, product, location, exemption and import facts establish the obligation?

questions.title: Entity, individual and information returns
questions.screening_question: Which taxpayer, income type, ownership, reporting threshold, return and filing period apply?

questions.title: Cross-border tax and transfer pricing
questions.screening_question: Which legal entities, related-party flows, treaties, withholding, permanent-establishment and transfer-pricing facts matter?

questions.title: Tax accounting methods and book-tax bridges
questions.screening_question: Which timing methods, elections, aggregation rules, method changes and transition cohorts govern book-tax differences?

questions.title: Acquisitions, combinations and joint ventures
questions.screening_question: What is acquired or formed, who controls it, and which consideration, opening-balance and measurement questions follow?

questions.title: Related parties and intercompany arrangements
questions.screening_question: Which ownership, common-control, service, funding and transfer terms need separate identification and evidence?

questions.title: Provisions, claims, warranties and guarantees
questions.screening_question: What obligation or exposure exists, what triggers recognition or disclosure, and how are ranges and recoveries supported?

questions.title: Purchased insurance and recoveries
questions.screening_question: Which coverage, deductibles, claims, premiums, cancellations and recovery rights affect the policyholder?

questions.title: Disposals, restructurings and insolvency
questions.screening_question: Which sale, closure, restructuring, liquidation or reorganization events change the accounting basis or obligations?

questions.title: Environmental obligations and related instruments
questions.screening_question: Which remediation, retirement, conservation, emissions or credit arrangements create measurable rights or obligations?

questions.title: Grants, contributions and restricted resources
questions.screening_question: Who provides resources, what conditions and restrictions attach, and how are spending, release and return duties evidenced?

questions.title: Government funds and budgetary reporting
questions.screening_question: Which fund, appropriation, budgetary basis, interfund flow and government-wide reconciliation applies?

questions.title: Federal and sovereign reporting
questions.screening_question: Which federal or sovereign reporting entity, budget authority, credit activity and stewardship obligations are relevant?

questions.title: Insurance and reinsurance obligations
questions.screening_question: Which underwriting, contract boundary, reserve, reinsurance, acquisition-cost and statutory-reporting questions apply?

questions.title: Lending, deposits and servicing
questions.screening_question: How do loan origination, servicing, transfers, deposits, guarantees and supervisory reports relate to the accounts?

questions.title: Funds, custody and fiduciary accounting
questions.screening_question: Whose assets are held, which fund or trust is the reporting unit, and how do fees, allocations and client-asset reconciliations work?

questions.title: Rate regulation and regulated cost recovery
questions.screening_question: Which rate-setting regime, recovery rights, obligations and regulatory accounts apply?

questions.title: Biological and extractive resources
questions.screening_question: Which growing, harvested, mineral, exploration, development or depletion stages require distinct analysis?

questions.title: Third-party reimbursement and cost reporting
questions.screening_question: How do service delivery, payer rules, contractual adjustments, estimates, settlements and cost reports reconcile?

questions.title: Licensed content, royalties and rights portfolios
questions.screening_question: Which territories, usage rights, minimum guarantees, production costs, royalties and participations attach to the content?

questions.title: Cost objects and allocation
questions.screening_question: Which products, services, jobs and responsibility centers consume the costs, and how are allocation bases reconciled?

questions.title: Budgets, forecasts and decision models
questions.screening_question: Which volume, price, capacity, cost and cash assumptions explain the plan and its uncertainty?

questions.title: Profitability and performance measures
questions.screening_question: How are margins, unit economics and non-GAAP measures defined and reconciled to financial records?

questions.title: Audit assertions and substantive evidence
questions.screening_question: What supports existence, completeness, rights, valuation and presentation for each material population?

questions.title: Internal control and fraud
questions.screening_question: Which error or fraud can occur, which control addresses it, and what evidence demonstrates its operation?

questions.title: Compliance and special-purpose assurance
questions.screening_question: Which engagement, regulated population, grant, contract or special-purpose criteria require separate assurance procedures?

questions.title: Professional duties and engagement governance
questions.screening_question: Which competence, independence, confidentiality, documentation and quality-management duties apply to the role?

questions.title: Source data, lineage and reconciliation
questions.screening_question: Can the complete source population, transformations, revisions and ledger ties be reproduced for the accounting question?

questions.title: Systems, documents and interoperability
questions.screening_question: Which contracts, schemas, identifiers, units, versions, exports and interface limitations govern the data?

questions.title: Security, privacy and access
questions.screening_question: Which access, tenant, retention, deletion, prompt-injection and information-disclosure boundaries apply?

questions.title: Agent architecture and reasoning
questions.screening_question: Which planning, tool-use, calculation and retrieval designs are supported for the accounting task and its failure conditions?

questions.title: Human review and action authority
questions.screening_question: Which judgments, exceptions and consequential actions require assigned authority, and how is review evidenced?

questions.title: Evaluation methods and transfer limits
questions.screening_question: What did the study measure, on which population and controls, and what cannot be inferred about other accounting work?

questions.title: Deployment, incidents and independent evidence
questions.screening_question: Which observed outcomes, costs, failures and independent replications establish real-world performance?

questions.title: Rights, provenance and reusable data
questions.screening_question: Which source-level permissions, consent, provenance and restrictions govern retrieval, redistribution and training reuse?
